references.label: Belfast Gazette issue 2209 (County Antrim (Electoral Areas) Order, 1963)
references.note: 20 Sep 1963, page 335. Made 13 Sep 1963. Re-composes Ballygomartin and Dunmurry CEDs following the Lisburn RD DED changes (former Malone DED split). Place and date checked against the text layer of the Gazette page.

references.label: Belfast Gazette issue 2147 (Donaghadee Urban District (provisional order))
references.note: 17 Aug 1962, page 306. Made 9 Aug 1962. Provisional order (confirmation act): National Assistance Act (Northern Ireland), 1948; places named: Donaghadee Urban District, Bangor Borough, Belfast, County Down; by Ministry of Finance; made 9 August 1962.

references.label: Belfast Gazette issue 2209 (Home Affairs and of the Newtownab'bey Urban District (Electoral Areas) Order (Northern Ireland) 1957)
references.note: 20 Sep 1963, page 336. Made 13 Sep 1963. District boundary altered: Home Affairs and of the Newtownab'bey Urban District (Electoral Areas) Order (Northern Ireland) 1957; places named: Lisburn Rural District, Lisburn Rural, County Antrim; by Ministry of Home Affairs / Ministry of Health and Local Government; made 13 September 1963.

approximateSegments.note: Some lines on this map are approximate: parts of the Bangor borough boundary are taken from the council's 1965 map of the existing boundary or the map of the 1966 Order, registered on the OSNI six-inch Edition 5 sheets (about 20-25 m); parts of the other town and ward lines are traced from the maps deposited with their Orders (about 20-25 m); Newtownabbey's line against the rural districts follows whole townlands read from a small-scale scheme map and is not confirmed. They are drawn dotted on the map.
